'''Ultrastellar Aesthetic Consultancy''' was a decorating firm that was headquartered on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[K'torna]] worked for the company.<ref name="Strongholds" />
